author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಿನ್ನನೀ ಹೊಗಳುವುದು ತೆಗಳುವುದು ತರವಲ್ಲ
ಚಿನ್ನದಂತಿಹ ನಿನ್ನ ನಿಸ್ಪೃಹತೆ ಬೆಳಗು
ಕನ್ನ ಹಾಕುವ ಮನದ ಅವಗುಣವ ಬಿಡುತಿರಲು
ಭಿನ್ನನೀ ಜನರಿಂದ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: It is not right to praise yourself, nor to run yourself down;
keep casting out the mind’s thieving faults,
and you will stand apart from the crowd, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Neither self-praise nor self-contempt helps. Cultivate a quiet freedom from wanting, drop the faults that steal your peace, and you will become someone rare.
